pk.title: Passkey for check-in
pk.intro: Use your phone's own screen lock to prove it is you when you check in and out.
pk.what1: A passkey is a key that stays on your phone. Your phone asks for your fingerprint, face or screen-lock PIN before using it, the same way it unlocks.
pk.what2: FairShift never sees or stores your fingerprint, face or PIN. It stores only a public key that can check your phone's answer.
pk.what3: Once you add a passkey, every check-in and check-out asks your phone to confirm it is you, so nobody else can mark your attendance with your account.
pk.none: You have no passkey yet. Check-in uses your sign-in only.
pk.requiredNote: Because you have a passkey, check-in and check-out ask your phone to confirm it is you.
pk.addTitle: Add a passkey on this phone
pk.labelHint: So you can tell your phones apart, for example "My Redmi".
pk.enrolled: Passkey added: {label}. Your next check-in will ask your phone to confirm it is you.
pk.cancelled: The phone check was cancelled or timed out. Nothing was recorded. Try again.
pk.deviceFailed: Your phone could not complete the check. Nothing was recorded. Try again, or ask your supervisor.
pk.noSupport: This browser cannot use passkeys. Keep using your sign-in to check in, or try Chrome or Safari on your phone.
pk.noScreenLock: This phone has no screen lock that passkeys can use. Set a fingerprint, face unlock or screen-lock PIN in your phone's settings first.
pk.serverOff: Passkeys are not set up on this FairShift server yet. Check-in uses your sign-in.
pk.recoveryTitle: If you lose or change your phone
pk.recovery1: Sign in on the new phone with your number and PIN, remove the old phone here, then add a passkey on the new one.
pk.recovery2: If you cannot sign in, ask your supervisor to reset your passkeys. You can then check in with your sign-in.
pk.recovery3: If the passkey check does not work on a day, your supervisor can record your attendance by hand. It is marked as a correction in your records.
pk.removeBody: This phone will no longer be able to confirm your check-ins. If it was your only passkey, check-in goes back to using your sign-in.
pk.confirming: Confirm it is you on your phone (fingerprint, face or screen lock)…
pk.offer: Protect check-in with your phone's screen lock
